    t = str(t)

    total = 0
    m = re.search(r"(\d+)\s*h", t)

    m = re.search(r"(\d+)\s*'", t)
    if m: total += int(m.group(1)) * 60
    m = re.search(r"(\d+)\s*\"", t)
